  ⎿  · D7 — Issue 5: Should the dependency graph be computed once on the first attempt and reused on retries, or recomputed on every retry as planned?
     Project/branch/task: main branch; 'background job retry framework' plan, Performance section (review-input.md:21-23).
     ELI10: Every retry currently reloads the whole job payload and rebuilds the same dependency graph from it, even though the payload has not changed. Computing the graph once, saving it on the job record with a version stamp, and reusing
     it on later attempts removes that repeated work. If the payload does change, the stamp mismatch forces a rebuild.
     Stakes if we pick wrong: Recompute-always multiplies database reads and CPU by the attempt count exactly when the system is already unhealthy (that is why jobs are retrying); a cache without a version check could reuse a stale graph.
     Recommendation: 5A because retries happen under load, the input is immutable per job, and a version-stamped cache is explicit and a few lines with CC.
     Completeness: A=9/10, B=6/10
     Net: A small persisted field plus an invalidation check versus paying the full rebuild on every attempt during outages. → 5A Compute once, persist, reuse (recommended)

      343 +### Accepted plan amendment (R5, D7=5A)                                                                                                                                                                                       
      344 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      345 +**Performance (replaces original):** On attempt 1, compute the dependency                                                                                                                                                     
      346 +graph and persist it on the job record alongside a `payloadVersion`                                                                                                                                                           
      347 +(hash or monotonically increasing version of the payload). On retry, if the                                                                                                                                                   
      348 +stored version matches the current payload version, reuse the graph and                                                                                                                                                       
      349 +skip the walk; otherwise recompute and overwrite. Do not add a second                                                                                                                                                         
      350 +explicit payload fetch if the library already re-hydrates the job on                                                                                                                                                          
      351 +re-enqueue (verify during implementation; Finding 4.1).                                                                                                                                                                       
      352 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      353 +```                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      354 +attempt k ──► job.graph && job.payloadVersion == hash(payload) ?                                                                                                                                                              
      355 +                 │ yes                          │ no                                                                                                                                                                          
      356 +                 ▼                              ▼                                                                                                                                                                             
      357 +           reuse graph                  walk payload → graph                                                                                                                                                                  
      358 +                                        persist graph + version                                                                                                                                                               
      359 +```                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
      360 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      361 +Required tests (proof of approved R5): cache hit skips the walk (spy on the
